query: Please implement an instant messaging plugin to provide more chat emoticons. The plugin should have the functionality to send and receive emoticons, and users should be able to select and send various emoticons, as well as customize them. The plugin should also have real-time update and notification functionality, allowing users to receive new messages and updates in a timely manner. Apply light sky blue for layout; use dodger blue for buttons and cards.
